allowed_claim: Scholar or series counts describe observed presentations in the indexed Zograf/Roerich archive.
required_evidence: Stable presentation IDs, source programme links, and rebuild validation.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not infer scholarly importance, productivity, seniority, or career quality from raw counts.

allowed_claim: Institutional statements may describe programme affiliations or verified affiliation spans.
allowed_scope: Programme metadata and manually verified trajectories only.
required_evidence: Source-backed affiliation span or explicit programme affiliation text.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim institutional dominance or complete employment history from city labels.

allowed_claim: Authority-ID coverage may be reported as index visibility and disambiguation status.
required_evidence: Per-source coverage counts and candidate review queues.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not interpret absence from OpenAlex, RINC, Wikipedia, ORCID, Wikidata, or VIAF as low scholarly productivity.

allowed_claim: Theme and meso codes are title-derived navigation and hypothesis-support labels.
allowed_scope: Presentation titles and reviewed classification samples.
required_evidence: Classification reliability packet, uncertainty queues, and manual overrides.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not present a theme code as a full content analysis of the paper.

allowed_claim: Network measures describe positions in explicitly typed observed conference networks.
allowed_scope: Chosen edge model and observed archive years.
required_evidence: Network edge definitions, robustness checks, and sensitivity note.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not conflate co-presence, co-presentation, coauthorship, citation, mentorship, or intellectual influence.

allowed_claim: Cohort statements may describe first observed presentation, return, and absence inside the archive.
required_evidence: Debut timing, cohort survival, and missingness caveats.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim employment continuity, career exit, or disciplinary entry/exit without external evidence.

allowed_claim: Video coverage may describe which talks have known public recordings.
allowed_scope: Mapped media records and playlist sources.
required_evidence: Video list, mapping table, and source notes.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not treat recording availability as a status, importance, or quality metric.

allowed_claim: Publication or citation data may be added only as source-specific, field-aware signals.
allowed_scope: Matched external indexes with confidence and field/language caveats.
required_evidence: Author disambiguation dossier and field-normalized indicators.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not compare scholars, generations, or fields using raw works or raw citations.

allowed_claim: Conference infrastructure claims may describe sessions, venues, themes, and programme organization when source-backed.
required_evidence: Event ecology audit and source snippets.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not present the two conferences as the whole infrastructure of Russian Indology.

allowed_claim: Role claims may distinguish presenter, chair, organizer, editor, invited speaker, or memorial subject when the programme says so.
allowed_scope: Raw programme role wording and role taxonomy mapping.
required_evidence: Conference role taxonomy and source evidence.
forbidden_overclaim: Do not assign credit-like roles from name appearance alone.
